newsitem.title: UK: Mirror Group edges up after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Mirror Group edges up after H1 results.

text.p: Shares in Mirror Group Plc edged higher in early trade on Monday after the media company released first half results towards the upper end of forecasts.
Shares gained 4-1/2p to 206p by 0800 GMT in a generally weaker market.

Pre-tax pre-exceptional profits rose to 39.0 million stg in the six months to June 30, compared with 37.9 million stg in the same period in 1995. Analysts forecasts were in a range of 32.5 million to 41 million stg.
"The headline results were slightly better than expected, but also the shares were perhaps a bit oversold ahead of the numbers," one marketmaker said.
